title: Thoughts I Cannot Say Out Loud

current_concerns.primary_problems: Since my baby was born about ten weeks ago, I have been experiencing unwanted, distressing images of harm coming to her at home. I hate these images, avoid bathing her alone, and check on her frequently during the night.
current_concerns.goals: Stop the unwanted thoughts and feel safe caring for my daughter independently.
